name: com.gameframex.unity.sentry
description:
GameFrameX Sentry — log reporting module that sends Unity project logs to the Sentry platform in real time. Supports five log levels (Debug, Info, Warning, Error, Fatal), automatically stamps each entry with a Unity timestamp for issue tracking, and integrates with the GameFramework logging system. Uses Preserve attributes to survive Unity code stripping and keeps a lightweight helper implementation with minimal performance impact. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Sentry — 将 Unity 项目日志实时上报到 Sentry 平台的日志上报功能包。支持 Debug、Info、Warning、Error、Fatal 五个日志级别，自动为每条日志附加 Unity 时间戳以便问题追踪，并与 GameFramework 日志系统无缝集成。使用 Preserve 属性防止 Unity 代码裁剪，日志助手实现轻量、性能影响极小。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
